decisions: DormantPaperCandidate records publication age, recent citation/attention metrics, dormant_since and provenance without inventing missing measurements.
Detection requires explicit low-attention evidence from structured recent metrics or text cues; an old paper without attention evidence is excluded.
Age checks are deterministic and use an explicit as_of parameter; no wall-clock date or network lookup is hidden in the analyzer.
The module supports structured metadata and English text cues, preserves document order independence, and leaves sleeping-beauty semantics for P08-T09.
remaining_risks: Metrics are accepted as supplied and are not independently verified against citation providers.
Text extraction is English and heuristic; nuanced citation trajectories need structured time-series evidence.
limitations: No network, credentials, external dependencies, registry lookup or production write was used.
